text: UBS Group AG is SIX/NYSE-listed with a broad free float; the Swiss Confederation exited its crisis-era stake long ago. As of 31 Dec 2025 its >3% shareholders under FMIA disclosure were BlackRock Inc. (5.01%) and Norges Bank, Norway's central bank (4.90%, since reduced below 3%) -- so one recent significant shareholder was itself a sovereign entity, albeit as a passive financial investor rather than a controlling one.

source.name: UBS Group AG Form 20-F FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: the following entities held more than 3% of the total voting rights of UBS Group AG ... Norges Bank, Oslo 4.90 ... BlackRock Inc., New York 5.01
